BiblicalUsage: Zethar is one of the seven chamberlains who served King Ahasuerus, named once when the king sends for Queen Vashti. He has no words and no story beyond that summons — a servant in the court at the moment the kingdom turns. His full story lives on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a servant named once counts: God writes down the chamberlain as surely as the king.
